test.title: The case for a four-day week

paragraphs.text: The idea of a four-day working week has moved from the fringes into mainstream debate, and in my view the evidence so far deserves to be taken seriously. Trials in several countries have reported that most employees produced as much in four days as they had in five.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Critics say these trials prove little, because the companies that volunteered were already well managed. There is some truth in this. A business in crisis is unlikely to experiment with its timetable, so the results may flatter the idea.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Even so, the benefits reported by workers are hard to dismiss. People described sleeping better and spending more time with their families, and fewer of them left their jobs during the trial period. Replacing an employee is expensive, so lower staff turnover alone may cover part of the cost.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: What worries me is the assumption that one model will suit every job. A hospital cannot close its wards on Fridays, and a shorter week for nurses would simply require more nurses. For such sectors, a four-day week is a slogan rather than a plan.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: The case for a four-day week

items.quote: in my view the evidence so far deserves to be taken seriously
items.prompt: The writer thinks the four-day week should be considered seriously.

explanation.en: “in my view the evidence so far deserves to be taken seriously” — “in my view” marks the writer’s position, and it matches the statement → YES.
explanation.kk: «in my view the evidence so far deserves to be taken seriously» — «in my view» автордың ұстанымын көрсетеді, ол тұжырыммен сәйкес → YES.
explanation.ru: «in my view the evidence so far deserves to be taken seriously» — сигнал «in my view» показывает позицию автора, и она совпадает с утверждением → YES.

items.quote: There is some truth in this.
items.prompt: The writer rejects the claim that the trial companies were not typical.

explanation.en: Critics say the companies were unusual, and the writer answers “There is some truth in this” — partly agreeing. He does not reject the claim → NO.
explanation.kk: Сыншылар компаниялар ерекше болды дейді, ал автор «There is some truth in this» деп ішінара келіседі. Ол бұл пікірді жоққа шығармайды → NO.
explanation.ru: Критики говорят, что компании были особенными, и автор отвечает «There is some truth in this» — частично соглашается. Отвергать эту мысль он не стал → NO.

items.quote: fewer of them left their jobs during the trial period
items.prompt: The writer believes the trials did not last long enough.

explanation.en: “The trial period” is mentioned only as the time when fewer people left. The writer gives no view on how long the trials lasted → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «The trial period» тек аз адам жұмыстан кеткен уақыт ретінде аталады. Сынақтың ұзақтығы туралы автор пікір айтпайды → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «The trial period» упоминается только как время, когда меньше людей уволились. О длительности испытаний автор своего мнения не высказывает → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: Replacing an employee is expensive, so lower staff turnover alone may cover part of the cost
items.prompt: According to the writer, keeping staff for longer can save a company money.

explanation.en: “Replacing an employee is expensive, so lower staff turnover alone may cover part of the cost” — fewer people leaving means lower costs. That is the writer’s claim → YES.
explanation.kk: «Replacing an employee is expensive, so lower staff turnover alone may cover part of the cost» — жұмыстан кету азайса, шығын да азаяды. Автор дәл осыны айтады → YES.
explanation.ru: «Replacing an employee is expensive, so lower staff turnover alone may cover part of the cost» — меньше увольнений = меньше расходов. Автор утверждает именно это → YES.

items.quote: A hospital cannot close its wards on Fridays
items.prompt: The writer believes a four-day week would be easy to introduce in hospitals.

explanation.en: “A hospital cannot close its wards on Fridays … a slogan rather than a plan” — for hospitals the writer sees the idea as unrealistic → NO.
explanation.kk: «A hospital cannot close its wards on Fridays … a slogan rather than a plan» — автор аурухана үшін бұл идеяны шындыққа жанаспайды деп санайды → NO.
explanation.ru: «A hospital cannot close its wards on Fridays … a slogan rather than a plan» — для больниц автор считает идею нереалистичной → NO.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the claims of the writer in the reading passage? Write YES if the statement agrees with the claims of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the claims of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.
